title: 記憶抽出市場における欠落した観測記録：第42回月食事変に関する考察
author: 学者 ヘルマン

en.title: Missing Observation Records in the Memory Extraction Market: A Study on the 42nd Lunar Eclipse Incident
en.premise: In a city where the buying and selling of memories has been legalized, a phenomenon known as a "memory blank (recession)" is reported to occur only on the night of a specific lunar eclipse. This investigation follows a suspicious death in which the expensive memory titled "First Love Scene" vanished from the market, replaced by a counterfeit memory strikingly similar to a "Motive for Murder." By cross‑referencing fragmented logs left behind with three contradictory eyewitness testimonies, the full scope of a physically impossible, locked‑room memory swap is gradually revealed.

zh.title: 记忆抽取市场中缺失的观测记录：第42次月食事件研究
zh.premise: 在记忆买卖合法化的城市中，特定的月食之夜会出现所谓的“记忆空白（レセッション）”。本调查追踪一起可疑死亡案件：高价的“初恋の情景”在市场上消失，取而代之的是与“殺人の動機”极为相似的伪造记忆。通过比对残留的零碎日志和三位目击者相互矛盾的证词，揭示了在物理上不可能的密室中进行记忆置换的全貌。
